canonical_generator: contracts.new_operation_id() (op- + uuid4().hex — single source for all governed writers)
input_fingerprint_semantics: SHA-256 hex of the writer's canonical normalized input; canonicalization is writer-owned and must be stable for that writer's own inputs
replay_rule: same operation_id + same input fingerprint => replay (return the original result, never re-execute); same operation_id + different fingerprint => conflict (refuse — arch round-2 §1); unseen id => execute
